# telnyx_porting_orders (Data Source)

Lists porting orders, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_porting_order`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_activation_settings_fast_port_eligible` (Boolean) Filter results by fast port eligible
- `filter_activation_settings_foc_datetime_requested_gt` (String) Filter results by foc date later than this value
- `filter_activation_settings_foc_datetime_requested_lt` (String) Filter results by foc date earlier than this value
- `filter_customer_group_reference` (String) Filter results by customer_group_reference
- `filter_customer_reference` (String) Filter results by customer_reference
- `filter_end_user_admin_auth_person_name` (String) Filter results by authorized person
- `filter_end_user_admin_entity_name` (String) Filter results by person or company name
- `filter_misc_type` (String) A port can be either 'full' or 'partial'. When type is 'full' the other attributes should be omitted. One of `full`, `partial`.
- `filter_parent_support_key` (String) Filter results by parent_support_key
- `filter_phone_numbers_carrier_name` (String) Filter results by old service provider
- `filter_phone_numbers_country_code` (String) Filter results by country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code
- `filter_phone_numbers_phone_number_contains` (String) Filter results by full or partial phone_number
- `include_phone_numbers` (Boolean)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort_value` (String) Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order. One of `-activation_settings.foc_datetime_requested`, `-created_at`, `activation_settings.foc_datetime_requested`, `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `porting_orders` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders))

<a id="nestedatt--porting_orders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_orders`

Read-Only:

- `activation_settings` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders--activation_settings))
- `additional_steps` (List of String) For specific porting orders, we may require additional steps to be taken before submitting the porting order.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `customer_group_reference` (String) A customer-specified group reference for customer bookkeeping purposes
- `customer_reference` (String) A customer-specified reference number for customer bookkeeping purposes
- `description` (String) A description of the porting order
- `documents` (Attributes) Can be specified directly or via the `requirement_group_id` parameter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders--documents))
- `end_user` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders--end_user))
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this porting order
- `messaging` (Attributes) Information about messaging porting process. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders--messaging))
- `misc` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders--misc))
- `old_service_provider_ocn` (String) Identifies the old service provider
- `parent_support_key` (String) A key to reference for the porting order group when contacting Telnyx customer support. This information is not available for porting orders in `draft` state
- `phone_number_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders--phone_number_configuration))
- `phone_number_type` (String) The type of the phone number
- `phone_numbers` (Attributes Set) List of phone numbers associated with this porting order (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders--phone_numbers))
- `porting_phone_numbers_count` (Number) Count of phone numbers associated with this porting order
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `requirements` (Attributes List) List of documentation requirements for porting numbers. Can be set directly or via the `requirement_group_id` parameter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders--requirements))
- `requirements_met` (Boolean) Is true when the required documentation is met
- `status` (Attributes) Porting order status (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders--status))
- `support_key` (String) A key to reference this porting order when contacting Telnyx customer support. This information is not available in draft porting orders.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `user_feedback` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_orders--user_feedback))
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user (or organization) who requested the porting order
- `webhook_url` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--porting_orders--end_user--admin"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_orders.end_user.admin`

Read-Only:

- `account_number` (String) The authorized person's account number with the current service provider
- `auth_person_name` (String) Name of person authorizing the porting order
- `billing_phone_number` (String) Billing phone number associated with these phone numbers
- `business_identifier` (String) European business identification number. Applicable only in the European Union
- `entity_name` (String) Person Name or Company name requesting the port
- `pin_passcode` (String, Sensitive) PIN/passcode possibly required by the old service provider for extra verification
- `tax_identifier` (String) European tax identification number. Applicable only in the European Union


<a id="nestedatt--porting_orders--end_user--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_orders.end_user.location`

Read-Only:

- `administrative_area` (String) State, province, or similar of billing address
- `country_code` (String) ISO3166-1 alpha-2 country code of billing address
- `extended_address` (String) Second line of billing address
- `locality` (String) City or municipality of billing address
- `postal_code` (String) Postal Code of billing address
- `street_address` (String) First line of billing address



<a id="nestedatt--porting_orders--messaging"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_orders.messaging`

Read-Only:

- `enable_messaging` (Boolean) Indicates whether Telnyx will port messaging capabilities from the losing carrier. If false, any messaging capabilities will stay with their current provider.
- `messaging_capable` (Boolean) Indicates whether the porting order can also port messaging capabilities.
- `messaging_port_completed` (Boolean) Indicates whether the messaging porting has been completed.
- `messaging_port_status` (String) The current status of the messaging porting.


<a id="nestedatt--porting_orders--misc"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_orders.misc`

Read-Only:

- `new_billing_phone_number` (String) New billing phone number for the remaining numbers. Used in case the current billing phone number is being ported to Telnyx. This will be set on your account with your current service provider and should be one of the numbers remaining on that account.
- `remaining_numbers_action` (String) Remaining numbers can be either kept with their current service provider or disconnected. 'new_billing_telephone_number' is required when 'remaining_numbers_action' is 'keep'.
- `type` (String) A port can be either 'full' or 'partial'. When type is 'full' the other attributes should be omitted.


<a id="nestedatt--porting_orders--phone_number_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `porting_orders.phone_number_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `billing_group_id` (String) identifies the billing group to set on the numbers when ported
- `connection_id` (String) identifies the connection to set on the numbers when ported
- `emergency_address_id` (String) identifies the emergency address to set on the numbers when ported
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) identifies the messaging profile to set on the numbers when ported
- `tags` (Set of String)
